name: Xen Orchestra backup
description: Shows what Xen Orchestra (Vates VMS) backs up: for every virtual machine the newest backup, its age, the copies kept and whether the last run worked, plus the free space of the backup repositories and the failed runs of the last week. Netlens ties each backup to its VM by the UUID the XCP-ng / XenServer plugin uses, warns when a backup fails or is late, and lists VMs that have no backup. Read-only (GET).
author: Netlens

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.4.31 or newer (the Backups page).
